EXPOSED TERMINALS: Node A, D are outside of range of each other and in the miiddle Node B, C are inside of the range of each other. B sends to A currently and C wants to send to D. But C has to wait because it considers that it will has interference. However the transmission can take place as A is out of range of C. C is exposed to B.
concept_results.reasoning: The student identified two distinct mobile routing challenges (Hidden Terminals and Exposed Terminals). According to the partial credit rule, naming 1-3 challenges earns 0.5 marks.
